notes_for_editor: The NHLR is the only source that describes the tower itself (build, move, design, registration). The FFLOS listing confirms it stands (cite 5), and the 2019 Journal Sentinel article gives the same 1935 move year (cite 4) and describes the tower as still standing. Wikipedia and the Tower Heritage Center cover the ski hill, not the tower. The 1935 move date predates the hill's motorcycle-race years (1938-1940) and its 1941 ski-hill establishment; no source read explains when the tower reached the hill or where it stood before, so treat 1935 as the Register's and the Journal Sentinel's claim. The NHLR credits the 'Wisconsin Conservation Corps'; the sources read do not expand that name, so verify the builder before publishing. Staffing and fires are not in any source read. Climbing: the 2019 article calls the Mountain Fire Lookout Tower the only Wisconsin fire tower open to the general public for climbing and does not mention climbing at this tower, so access is unstated rather than confirmed; the brief's access 'unknown' is kept as unknown.
